projectDescription: An AI-powered CLI coding assistant that integrates Claude directly into your terminal for autonomous code editing, multi-agent task execution, and deep IDE integration.
keyFeatures: AI-powered coding assistant that runs directly in the terminal
Multi-agent and swarm support for parallel task execution
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration for extensibility
Hooks system for customizing behavior at tool execution lifecycle events
Skills system for reusable prompt workflows
Session management with resume and compact capabilities
Permissions and trust system for safe code execution
publicApiSurface: query() — Run a single AI prompt and stream results
tool() — Define custom MCP tools for the SDK
createSdkMcpServer() — Create an in-process MCP server
unstable_v2_createSession() — Create a persistent multi-turn session
unstable_v2_resumeSession() — Resume an existing session by ID
getSessionInfo() — Get metadata for a single session
getSessionMessages() — Read conversation messages from a session
CLI: claude mcp — Manage MCP servers
CLI: claude config — View and edit configuration
CLI: claude memory — Manage memory files (CLAUDE.md)
CLI: claude hooks — Manage lifecycle hooks
CLI: claude permissions — Manage tool permissions
CLI: claude session — List and resume sessions
CLI: claude model — Change the active model
